title: Note · A5 pre-printed note
slide_intent: Leave a generous area for handwriting while making the sender identifiable on a small sheet. An informal note needs both open space and dependable contact information.
strategic_value: A compact mark, faint curve and footer can identify Special Olympics while letting a personal message occupy the center of an A5 note.
demonstration: The A5 specimen places a 16 mm program mark at the top right, a pale gray gradient curve below it and a small contact block at the bottom.
practical_value: On a 148 × 210 mm note, position the mark about 8 mm from the top and right edges. Reserve the center for writing and choose the international mark for international communications.

content_islands.name: Production settings
content_islands.spec: At left give the A5 format and inks, followed by numbered settings for mark, contact type and gradient.

content_islands.name: Blank note and footer
content_islands.spec: Show a tall blank sheet on a pale ground. Indicate the faint curve with a dotted line and enlarge the red and gray contact block in a circular callout.
